name: dev-guide-64
prompt: The attached images are STYLE references only (classic Korean MMORPG pixel art). For more of that style, browse these two games and study their character sprites: 바람의나라: 연 https://baramy.nexon.com/ and 도깨비의세계 https://dokkaebi.kakaogames.com/preregister/ . Learn from them: thick 1px dark outlines, dithered shading, saturated but limited palette, about 3 to 3.5 heads tall with a large head and voluminous hair, slight 3/4 top-down view, light coming from the upper left. Then draw a NEW original character (not a copy of any reference): a 25-year-old German, the youngest person in the company, the dev team's builder whose hands move before the plan is finished, in Joseon-fantasy attire - short cropped light-brown hair (#8b5a2b) with a narrow white headband tied around the forehead, fair skin, two clearly visible dark eyes, an eager grin. Clothing: a knee-length olive-green cheollik coat (철릭, #4a5d3a, a practical pleated military-style hanbok) with the sleeves rolled up to the elbows, a dark belt, white pants, black shoes. Holds a small wooden mallet in the right hand. Requirements: one character, full body, idle standing pose, facing the viewer (south), centered on a flat solid magenta background (#FF00FF), no drop shadow, no text, no border, no scenery. Render as crisp pixel art about 64 pixels tall (head to feet), then upscale exactly 8x with nearest-neighbor so every logical pixel is a sharp 8x8 block on a 512x512 canvas, and give me that PNG to download.
note: 하네스가 시트 절을 64px 정지 그림 절로 바꿈 (대표 결정 2026-09-12)
